ModMetaData.name: Evolopes+Mechanites
ModMetaData.author: EnderNyktos
ModMetaData.description:
Welcome,
This mod adds the posibility to inject mechanites in the body of the evolopes and choose the resource given.
This adds: Chocolope (Chocolate), Devilope (Devilstrand), Jellope (Insect Jelly), Milkalope (Milk), Neutroalope (Neutroamine), MegaBoomalope (Synthread) and MegaLuciferope (Luciferium). MegaBoomalope and MegaLuciferope will consume twice the food, but produce also twice the products. Some of the evolopes are more dirty than others or don't like to be in the pen.
The products are calculated based on the boomalope's resource given in silver (25.3).
To create the Mechanites you will need: 2 advanced components, 1 glitterworld medicine and 20 of the chosen resource. Just get two of them and you can keep breeding the evolopes.
Don't apply it to another animal or pawn, the mechanites will sature the body and kill him.
I want this mod could be balanced, so just suggest any idea or another evolope to join.
